_comment: Input of tools/cut_sprites.py. Schema: defaults (cut parameters), scale_groups (one factor per group: measure height|width|extent|fit of the tallest/widest reference pose, value in px), kinds (cell, align foot|center, foot row, radius, prop, mirror_side, shadow -> sprites.json), sheets (key colour, rows -> pose count and outputs). Output poses are [from,to) in the row. ground 'row' keeps the row's shared ground line instead of putting every pose's soles on the foot row.

tamsin_walk._comment: Design and scale reference only (the old 6-pose sheet): no outputs. Scale groups player, player_walk_*, player_swing and player_states measure it.
